title: NPCore: Integrations
summary: Use optional addon bridges without making NPC contacts depend on every surface.

blocks.title: Screen And Terminal
blocks.body: ScreenCore can provide the richer NPC page, while Terminal can expose NPCore status and diagnostics. The classic screen remains the fallback.

blocks.title: Mission And Data
blocks.body: MissionCore can gate trade offers. DataCore can preserve stock, cooldowns, and conversion records so repeated interactions behave consistently.

blocks.title: World And Render Bridges
blocks.body: WorldCore and RenderCore are optional future-facing bridges for context and richer presentation. Missing them should not block dialogue, trades, or services.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
